notes: OneMDollar is implemented in src/OneMDollar.sol. Constructor arguments remain liquidityPool_, feeRecipient_, poolManager_; the full fixed 1e27 minor-unit supply is minted once to msg.sender. All transfers start untaxed (poolTaxEnabled is false). After launch the fixed feeRecipient must call enablePoolTax() separately; only that address is authorized and activation is permanent and repeat calls revert. Activation emits PoolTaxEnabled and changes no balances, allowances or supply. There is no on-chain launch-completion detector: the treasury is responsible for checking launch completion, venue compatibility and initial liquidity before activation. After activation transfers into or out of the immutable separately configured pool pay floor(amount * 9900 / 10000) to the treasury, including PoolManager relays. Other endpoints remain untaxed. The launch v4 PoolManager cannot be the taxable endpoint and its launch pool remains untaxed even after activation; the 3000 AMM fee is separate from the 99% token tax. The inherited first argument 0x1001 is a test fixture with no verified production venue; this manifest is not production-ready until the network operator supplies and verifies a functional fee-on-transfer-compatible separate pool. Inherited treasury and paired currency addresses are unverified by this assignment. The treasury must be able to call enablePoolTax and spend its received tokens. Parameters are nonzero, pairwise distinct and distinct from the token/deployer; they cannot be changed. No deployment, replacement, re-minting or transaction is performed by this source-only assignment. Source changes do not update an existing non-upgradeable token. See README.md for the activation runbook and operator responsibilities.
